compiled_state.title: Update project docs to reflect the Closure Checks schema, migration process, and planning artifact changes
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story

As a developer working on the DSO plugin after the Closure Checks migration, I can find accurate documentation in the right places — design docs capture the schema rationale and migration path; CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md lists any new config keys; workflow docs reflect updated processes; and KNOWN-ISSUES.md is pruned of superseded entries.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: `docs/designs/closure-checks/` directory created with a design document: schema spec, rationale (why separate end-state from transitional), migration path, and backward-compat contract
- DD2: `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` updated for any new config keys added during S1–S5 (e.g., `project_closure_hooks`, hook config pattern)
- DD3: Workflow docs updated where Closure Checks affects process (e.g., COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md, VERIFIER-PROTOCOL.md, any workflow that mentions success criteria validation)
- DD4: `docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md` pruned — remove workaround entries superseded by the Closure Checks migration

← Satisfies: "SC documentation: project docs updated to reflect new schema"

## Considerations

- Note: CLAUDE.md Quick Reference update ships with **S3**, not here — see S3 DD3. This story covers design docs, config reference, and workflow docs only.
- Coordinate with S4/S5 authors to capture any config keys or known-issues discovered during implementation.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
